facts.fact: Usha knows from the queen's household that a ledger page burned of itself at the Resin House two nights past the new moon (the dusk of Neela's self-naming, not the new-moon night itself), and asks what the naming cost; she does not name the shape. Neela tells her publicly only the wound-share. Revises the earlier new-moon wording.
Neela tells Usha that Devan nicked his chin shaving 'three days back' and she found the welt over her rice. No weekday names are used.

At the end of ch 2 Neela and Devan state the cost of Usha's door aloud: Kodiyur is four hard days away and the raiders reach the gorge in three, so taking the door means Devan leaving the pass he swore to the Company's fire to hold, or Neela going alone.
